name: Sandpines (central Oregon coast: bentgrass links among dunes, lakes and shore pine)
note: Course theme palette (<= 32 colours; same keys as pnw.json plus F0-F2). Sandpines Golf Links, Florence OR (Rees Jones, 1993): emerald bentgrass fairways, tees and greens (greener and cooler than Bandon's fescue); mown rough in the G3-G5 greens (lut rough_band); tawny European beachgrass on the native dune areas and the mounds along the fairways (F0-F2, drawn where data/sandpines/proposed/native.geojson says, config fescue_areas); near-white bunker sand and pale dune sand; blue dune lakes; shore pine and Sitka spruce woods (assets-src/trees_sandpines.py). Draft hues from the club's photos in the GitHub release florence-data (2026-10-24), to be checked against the OSIP 2024 orthophoto; saturated for the game's style. Shadows are a 35% black overlay on top of these.
